This is an auxiliary local projective-cover theorem, not a verbatim numbered assertion. The actual right-chart replacement has a closed graph in a finite product of projective lines over the original coefficient ring. The induction retains the whole D(u) section and normalized initial-product projective coordinates, so all coordinates extend across the unchanged first chart. No blowup identification, compatible descent across etale overlaps or global alteration is asserted.
